readings._audit: 2026-10-05 re-pick under the settled conventions (z = -m; side far = bodyside left of the face = train's right). Old solve was degenerate (focal 3.9e9, rms 110 px): 9 fit points with three mislabelled/unsupported (band-start-top was on the cab door, not a band; seam points on the curved cab corner; one modelFace point), nothing below waist level on the bodyside and no spread in depth on the face. Replaced with 25 points: lamps incl. the round lamp, door seal corners, screen surround corners, door corners incl. bottoms, window corners. Window points are on the window band (spec windowBandY [1.75,2.865]) at each pane's frame edge: the model draws the band at those heights, not the panes, which are ~0.1 m shorter in the photo.

readings._result: 2026-10-05: fit rms 17.4 px, held-out 2.3/4.8/4.7 cm (ok). Bodyside alone (p208side) fits at 6.0 px; the excess is the face: seal tops and the screen surround's top corner read ~0.10 m low against the bodyside camera (seal bottoms and screen bottoms ~0.02-0.06), lamps ~0.05 low. Picks re-checked on 90 px panels; this is a model finding (face top too high, or the face's upper rake too shallow). Cab door rear / first pane front are ~0.1 m closer together in the photo than the spec (0.58 m).
